facts.fact: Goobjoog reports the Federal Government launched the Justice Sector Integrated Electronic Case Management System (IECMS) in Mogadishu on 9 October 2025, linking the CID, the Office of the Prosecutor, the courts and the prison service in one electronic workflow that officials say replaces the paper-based process.
